title: The cheapest label can hide a route
hook: One route is cheaper and one is faster. Which can we discard?

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Keep nondominated time-cost labels when no single scalar distance captures the constraint.

misconception: The cheapest label at a vertex dominates every more expensive label.
objective: Keep nondominated time-cost labels when no single scalar distance captures the constraint.

claims.text: Nondominated time-cost labels preserve alternatives under a resource limit.
